title: filter ghosts
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkGeometryFilter ghost cell handling across multiple mesh types with HIDDENCELL and DUPLICATECELL flags, with and without RemoveGhostInterfaces, arranged in a 5x4 viewport grid.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkAppendFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAppendFilter.html) — append filter.
- [vtkDataSetAttributes](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetAttributes.html) — data set attributes.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGeometryFilter.html) — extracts the outer surface of a dataset.
- [vtkImageData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageData.html) — represents a regular grid of points (image/volume).
- [vtkImageToStructuredGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageToStructuredGrid.html) — image to structured grid.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) — int array.
- [vtkRectilinearGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRectilinearGrid.html) — rectilinear grid.
- [vtkTextActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTextActor.html) — text actor.
- [vtkUnsignedCharArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnsignedCharArray.html) — unsigned char array.
- [vtkUnstructuredGridToExplicitStructuredGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGridToExplicitStructuredGrid.html) — unstructured grid to explicit structured grid.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
